label: Strict explanatory priority and joint existential import of nature records
summary: PR #1969 checkpoint D, docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, based on 9765c079c3b4d3490bfa31a581f9ab672c1b6b16. Reuses #1595/#1742, IntrinsicReasonBoundary.ActualRecord and selectedNatureRecord (candidate classification), EssenceReasonSeparation, ExistenceIngredient, HistorySelection.characterization, #1097 WorldwiseCompositeGround.ReplacementCertificate and the separate #1887 existence-in-essence analysis. For one existence fact e, a nonempty strict full-ground record must avoid e and its strict explanatory successors under the stipulated transitive irreflexive fact priority and contributor policy. Let L be all remaining actually true candidate reason facts. If a common target-absent interpretation preserves L, no eligible record entails e on that interpretation class. Conversely if every omission eliminates some member of L and there is at least one omission, L entails e there, not necessarily as a real admissible full ground. Per-ingredient omissions are insufficient: two individually insufficient facts may jointly determine existence. Tested 4,282 finite mask/family cases (all nonempty omission families up to three candidate facts, all pairs with repetition at four), plus a matched law/blueprint/realized constitution and joint-only control. For a necessary whole W, existential fact priority from W to an actual proper part p, from E(p) to the actual instantiated constitution K(W), and from K(W) to E(W) contradict the same strict priority. This excludes the selected circular explanation, not priority monism or composition; the constituent-to-constitution priority bridge and real existential content are open. Abstract structure plus laws that survive a common omission cannot entail the concrete target on that class. The same tests apply to the subsistent-esse proposal: identity or an already posterior actual exercise cannot strictly ground itself; independently warranted nonposterior existential nature content remains live for both accounts. Corrected checkpoint B's erroneous all-world scope extension: actual root plus contingent grounding and EM yields necessary actual concrete root and b19ffd92, not 0bdcf366. Two-world rotating necessary roots witness this nonentailment; all-world transport remains separate. No change to reviewed prior assessments, no new formal result or metaphysical possibility claim.
blocker: The subsequent duet comparison individuates an activity by provenance. It leaves open whether this individual’s nature explains why its act is exercised. A whole supplying its parts qualifies as a relative root given that it has no incoming cause in the selected relation. Reopen on warranted existential nature-content for this bearer or independent evidence that a constituent supplies this whole’s existence. The connection from intrinsic adequacy a7bbd2fd to a God-existence argument remains planned.
